_comment: Provenance manifest for data/external/ dumps. One entry per directory. TRUSTED = verified license permits our use; RESEARCH-ONLY = usable internally, not redistributable; UNTRUSTED = license missing/unverified, do not release derivatives or train on it without checking. Update this file BEFORE using any new dump. See docs/vn_legal_data_sources_2026-10-08.md for the full investigation.

zalo2021.upstream: Zalo AI Challenge 2021 (challenge.zalo.ai); corpus scraped from thuvienphapluat.vn
zalo2021.notes: Mirror packaging is MIT; upstream platform terms may still restrict redistribution of thuvienphapluat-derived text. Full dump has 3,298 qrels (MTEB card understates).

alqac2024.upstream: ALQAC 2024 shared task; Pham et al., Int. J. of Asian Language Processing 2024
alqac2024.license_stated: research purposes only; commercial use requires author contact
alqac2024.notes: Free-text answers; article gold absent from dump (harvest via citation extractor, then human-verify).

alqac2025.upstream: ALQAC 2025 (alqac.github.io); canonical repo huggingface.co/datasets/nguyenlab/ALQAC is GATED
alqac2025.notes: Do not train or release derivatives until the canonical license is verified or access to nguyenlab/ALQAC is granted.

tvpl_vbpl.notes: 121-shard structured corpus (~738k docs): doc_type/tier/legal_area/citations pre-parsed. Spot-verify a sample against official vbpl.vn before releasing any derivative.

tvpl_hdpl.upstream: scraped from thuvienphapluat.vn 'Hoi dap phap luat' consultation section
tvpl_hdpl.notes: Consultation Q&A; user questions are real-citizen text - paraphrase before publishing anything.

tvpl_tnpl.upstream: scraped from thuvienphapluat.vn 'Tinh huong phap luat' case/situation section

hoidap_200k.notes: ~200k consultation Q&A pairs; same upstream-platform caveat as zalo2021.

legal_claim_verification.notes: evidence_passages + verifier train/val. Verify authorship/paper before any use beyond internal reading.

vibidlqa.upstream: KSE 2024 paper 'Vietnamese Legal QA: An Experimental Study'; LLM-drafted questions validated by legal experts; Vietnamese bidding law

vlegal_bench.upstream: VLegal-Bench / CMC-OpenAI (arXiv 2512.14554); HF org CMC-OPENAI publishes model only
vlegal_bench.notes: ND clause: evaluate + cite only; NO derivatives, NO merging into our released bundle, NO redistribution under our name. 22 MCQ tasks, 23 jsonl, 77 MB.

not_downloaded.vlqa_canonical: arXiv 2507.19995 dataset - UNRELEASED (paper says 'coming soon'); email authors for access
not_downloaded.court_portals: ansvn/congbobanan/anle.toaan.gov.vn - DNS-blocked from this machine; user browser fetch
not_downloaded.news_corpora: jasong03/vov_phapluat, jasong03/nhandan_phapluat, myduy/vnexpress_plain_text_phap_luat - open but NO license stated; UNTRUSTED until provenance checked
